pr_title: Variable Granularity support for data collection
pr_body:

Describe the change in summary section, including rationale and degin decisions.
Include "Fixes #nnn" if you are fixing an existing issue.

In "Component Name" section write which component is changed in this PR. This
will help us review your PR quicker.

If you have more information you want to add, write them in "Additional
Information" section. This is usually used to help others understand your
motivation behind this change. A step-by-step reproduction of the problem is
helpful if there is no related issue.
-->

##### Summary
Fixes #6254 
Fixes #6255
Fixes #6487
Fixes #6573
Variable Granularity support for data collection in netdata.
##### Component Name
daemon
database
web
backends
##### Additional Information
Allow users to change data collection frequency of metrics without:
- deleting older chart data
- invalidating existing alarm data
- affecting streaming
- invalidating web server data queries of older data
- affecting backends

issue_context.title: Netdata variable granularity support in dbengine
issue_context.body:
<!---
When creating a feature request please:
- Verify first that your issue is not already reported on GitHub
- Explain new feature briefly in "Feature idea summary" section
- Provide a clear and concise description of what you expect to happen.
--->

##### Feature idea summary
Netdata variable granularity support in dbengine.
##### Expected behavior
dbengine API will need to implement API calls than enable variable granularity of data collection frequency of metrics collected by netdata or other API users (see #6255).
